messages:
ana: heads up — scorecard diff view is showing different total sample counts than the CSV export after the runner sampling change. chart sums to 9,812 but export is 10,000. noticed on nightly run for model-chan-v2 :thinking_face:

mike: hmm. is that the new deterministic sampling PR (shard-based) we merged yesterday?

ana: yes — PR #4187. i can repro on the failing CI artifact (run id 2026-03-19T23:40). i grabbed the console chart vs CSV and they disagree on bucket counts for "length_bin".

devon: can you paste the query / eval config used?

ana: sure — this is the runner sample config snippet we used:
```
sampling: 
  strategy: deterministic_shard
  seed: 42
  target_sample: 10000
```

ana: and the scorecard pipeline does an on-the-fly aggregation on the incoming sample before rendering.

sara: CI already flagged test-scorecard-aggregation in the nightly job, looks related. ci-bot, do you have the failure log id?

ci-bot: CI: eval-runner-tests failed in job 67291. Test 'test_scorecard_aggregation_counts' expected 10000 total samples in export but got 9812. Full log: https://ci.internal/67291/logs/agg-mismatch

mike: thanks. two hypotheses: (1) sampling happens before label mapping / bucketing so deterministic shard took a slightly different distribution and UI agg assumes post-mapped counts; (2) exporter de-duplicates or drops records when serializing due to a new compacting path.

eva: i inspected the runner produced JSON payload — it contains 10k items. exporter->gzip step has a small dedupe sanitizer we added for memory reasons — maybe that's dropping entries with identical ids?

devon: good catch. if exporter is deduping on request_id but deterministic_shard can produce shard collisions (same request sampled multiple times across reruns) then it's plausible. but in this CI run it's a single run, so collisions shouldn't happen. can someone dump the ids distribution?

ana: uploaded a small sample: https://artifacts/internal/2026-03-19/ids-sample.json (first 200 lines). quick look shows ~188 duplicates in the export payload before gzip. not sure where duplicates introduced.

mike: if duplicates exist in the raw payload, UI agg might be using the unique-id dimension and dropping dupes when building chart, while CSV exporter naively wrote all rows — that would make CSV larger. but your earlier note said CSV bigger (10k) and chart smaller (9812), which is consistent (CSV includes duplicates, UI dedupes).

eva: right. exporter sanitizer probably removed duplicates during compression but the CSV writer used the pre-sanitized stream. bug: mismatch in where dedupe is applied in pipeline. fix is to centralize dedupe (either always apply before both charting and CSV or never).

devon: plan: i'll add a unit test to ensure sample count is invariant across chart and CSV paths. i'll move dedupe into the ingestion layer so both downstream consumers see the same canonical stream. mike — can you change the UI to show a small badge if dedupe happened ("samples deduped: N") until we fix?

mike: yep, i can add a temporary banner + tooltip. will also log the raw vs canonical counts to help postmortem.

sara: assigning: devon -> runner/exporter patch, mike -> UI badge, ana -> reproduce steps & upload failing artifacts, eva -> confirm dedupe root cause. i'll create a small ticket and link PRs. :thumbsup:

ana: thanks all — leaving the artifact links in the ticket. ping me if you need the exact sample slice.

ci-bot: CI: rerun requested by sara. Job queued 67292.

devon: quick note: adding the unit test found a flake in the deterministic_shard ordering when seed=0; will include fix in same branch.

mike: ack. deploying UI patch to staging once devon's branch lands.

ana: nice, marking this investigate -> fix in the dashboard. nice triage, folks. :rocket:
